notes_for_editor: Register and firelookout.com agree on about 1932 and gone by 1969. The Forest Lookouts page (survey text) adds a 1964 deactivation and a 1970 note that the house was destroyed with the foundation remaining; it is the last physical description found. No source describes the site today. The Forest Lookouts page does describe the route in (a 1.5-hour pack, with a well-marked trail from where truck travel ends) but does not say whether the area is open to visitors. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the 1970 date and the east-end location now have quotes. The Forest Lookouts listing also carries a 'Removed' status line, not used as evidence because its meaning is unclear. Survey mark stamped 'ZIGZAG 1953' is not a lookout date and is not used. Three pages read; no web search used.
